agent.request: Practice explaining the duration of the coffee tasting.

decision.reason: Practice explaining the duration of the coffee tasting.

scenario.title: A guest has only half an hour
scenario.guest: Our driver leaves in 30 minutes. Can we still do something meaningful?
scenario.goal: Recognize the 30-minute limit; Offer the verified 20-minute tasting, not the full tour; Ask when the guest needs to start

answers_request.0: Misses the main request or reverses its meaning
answers_request.1: Addresses only part of the request

factual_accuracy.0: Contradicts facts or invents a promise, price, policy or safety claim
factual_accuracy.1: No contradiction, but important factual limits are omitted
factual_accuracy.2: Uses only supplied facts and states relevant limits

clarifies_unknowns.0: Guesses a missing detail or ignores necessary clarification
clarifies_unknowns.1: Identifies the gap but does not ask a useful question or offer a check
clarifies_unknowns.2: Offer the verified 20-minute tasting, not the full tour

next_step.0: No usable next step, or an unauthorized commitment
next_step.1: Vague next step or unclear ownership
next_step.2: Ask when the guest needs to start

critical_errors: Promise the full 60-minute tour fits in 30 minutes
scenario.source_note: Original synthetic dialogue; sources inform competency design, not customer quotations.
